messages:
elaine-sales: Quick question — Acme wants a scoped hosted token for a 2-week POC. They need IP allowlist + minimal scopes. Who should I loop in for provisioning?
raj-solutions: I can take this. We usually issue a scoped token tagged with the deal id, TTL 14d, and enable IP allowlist. Need customer contact + CIDR ranges.
acme-rep: Hey Elaine — thanks. We can provide two office CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/28. Contact is jeff@acme.com.
sarah-eng: FYI, for hosted POC keys we prefer short-lived tokens from our token service rather than long-lived static creds. Two options: console provision (manual) or API call. If you want API, sample:```POST /v1/pocs/keys
{
  "scopes": ["generate:text","embeddings:read"],
  "ttl": "14d",
  "allowlist": ["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.0/28"],
  "meta": {"deal":"ACME-42"}
}```
mike-secs: @raj-solutions please confirm LOA (we need written approval from Acme for outbound IPs). Also confirm whether SSO is required for Console access. For security, we recommend rotating after 7 days for public demos.
raj-solutions: Got it. @mike-secs I have the LOA in the email thread (forwarded). Acme doesn't need Console access — they'll call the hosted API only. I'll tag token as read-only scopes.
elaine-sales: Thanks. Any cost/limits we should flag to the customer? They might run embeddings heavy for a demo.
raj-solutions: I'll attach a soft quota: 5k tokens/min and 100k embedding units total for the two-week window. If they need more we can bump to Dedicated trial but that'll need procurement.
deploy-bot: Key issued by raj-solutions — id: key_poc_ACME_9 (expires 2025-07-03T18:23:00Z). Access secret delivered via secure vault link.
acme-rep: Confirmed received the secure link. Running first smoke test now.
sarah-eng: Quick tip for the smoke test — use header Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN> and include X-Project: ACME-42. Example curl: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -H "X-Project: ACME-42" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'```
acme-rep: Smoke test passed. Latency looks good.
mike-secs: I'll schedule a mid-POC check on day 7 to rotate the token. Plan: create replacement, update 1Password link, revoke old token in console. @raj-solutions any objections?
raj-solutions: No objections. I'll create rotation runbook and set calendar reminder.
elaine-sales: Perfect — I'll update the deal notes and add usage/cost guardrails. Thanks team :thumbsup:
